name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
overview: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of landholding farmer families.
description: Income support of ₹6,000/year to all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits_summary: ₹6,000 per year (3 installments of ₹2,000 each via DBT)
benefits_details: ₹2,000 every 4 months directly into Aadhaar-linked NPCI mapped bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria_text: Landholder farmer family with cultivable land in official land records. Institutional landholders, government employees (Class I, II, III), income tax payers, and constitutional post holders are excluded.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile for OTP/eKYC)

application_steps.title: Check Digitized Land Records
application_steps.description: Ensure your land parcel is updated on your state revenue portal (e.g. Bhulekh/Bhoomi).

application_steps.title: Open PM-KISAN Portal
application_steps.description: Visit https://pmkisan.gov.in and click 'New Farmer Registration'.

application_steps.title: Enter Aadhaar & Land Survey Details
application_steps.description: Fill state, district, block, village, khata and survey/khasra numbers.

application_steps.title: Complete Mandatory eKYC
application_steps.description: Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) for biometric verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
overview: Comprehensive risk insurance covering preventable and non-preventable yield losses, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities for notified crops.
description: Crop insurance covering pre-sowing to post-harvest losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefits_summary: Crop loss compensation; farmer pays only 1.5% premium for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, 5% for commercial/horticulture
benefits_details: Balance actuarial premium is 100% subsidized by Central & State governments.
eligibility_criteria_text: All farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance areas are eligible, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers with valid sowing proof.

required_documents.name: Sowing Certificate / Declaration from Patwari or Agri Officer

application_steps.title: Confirm Crop Notification
application_steps.description: Check if your crop and district are notified on the PMFBY portal for the ongoing season.

application_steps.title: Submit Application Before Cut-off
application_steps.description: Apply online at https://pmfby.gov.in, via bank branch, or nearest CSC.

application_steps.title: Pay Subsidized Farmer Premium
application_steps.description: Pay nominal premium (1.5% Rabi / 2% Kharif) and preserve policy receipt.

application_steps.title: Report Local Calamity in 72 Hours
application_steps.description: In case of hailstorm or localized flooding, report via Crop Insurance App or call 14447 within 72 hours.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
overview: Short-term institutional credit for crop cultivation, inputs purchase, farm maintenance, and animal husbandry at a subsidized 4% effective interest rate.
description: Short-term credit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and farm assets at 4% interest.
benefits_summary: Credit up to ₹3,00,000 at 4% interest (7% normal minus 3% prompt repayment incentive)
benefits_details: Collateral-free limit up to ₹1.60 lakh. Available also for dairy and fisheries up to ₹2 lakh.
eligibility_criteria_text: All owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHG/JLG farmer groups are eligible.

application_steps.title: Obtain Simplified 1-Page Form
application_steps.description: Download from NABARD/pmkisan.gov.in or pick up at your local bank branch.

application_steps.title: Attach KYC & Land Details
application_steps.description: Attach copies of Aadhaar, land record extract, and photos.

application_steps.title: Submit to Bank Branch / PACS
application_steps.description: Submit at your nearest cooperative, rural, or commercial bank.

application_steps.title: Sanction within 14 Days
application_steps.description: RBI guidelines mandate processing eligible KCC applications within 14 days.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
overview: Subsidizes precision micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water efficiency and crop yields.
description: Har Khet Ko Pani -- 55% subsidy on drip and sprinkler systems for small and marginal farmers.
benefits_summary: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers; 45% for Other farmers (State top-up in many states reaches 70%-90%)
benefits_details: Central + state shared subsidy for BIS-certified drip and sprinkler installations with 3-5 years empanelled maintenance warranty.
eligibility_criteria_text: Farmers owning or leasing land with an assured water source (borewell/canal/well). Priority for small and marginal farmers.

required_documents.name: Proof of Assured Water Source (Borewell / Well / Canal)

application_steps.title: Register on State Horticulture Portal
application_steps.description: Apply through your state's agricultural/horticultural DBT portal.

application_steps.title: Empanelled Vendor Field Survey
application_steps.description: Authorized vendor surveys the farm layout and prepares a technical quote.

application_steps.title: Department Sanction Order
application_steps.description: District horticulture officer issues work order for installation.

application_steps.title: Geotagging & Subsidy Credit
application_steps.description: Field inspection verifies installation and subsidy is transferred via DBT.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
overview: Subsidizes off-grid standalone solar pumps (up to 7.5 HP) and solarisation of existing grid agricultural tubewells.
description: Standalone solar pump installation with up to 60% combined Central and State financial support.
benefits_summary: 30% Central grant + 30% State subsidy; farmer contributes ~10%-40% (bank loan available for balance)
benefits_details: Replacement of expensive diesel pumps with zero electricity bill solar pumping setups.
eligibility_criteria_text: Farmers with agricultural land and confirmed ground/surface water source. One solar pump per family.

application_steps.title: Check State Renewable Energy Agency
application_steps.description: Find your State Nodal Agency (e.g. BREDA in Bihar, UPNEDA in UP, KREDL in Karnataka).

application_steps.title: Apply on Official .gov.in Portal
application_steps.description: Ensure portal URL ends with .gov.in to protect against fake scam portals.

application_steps.title: Pay Farmer Share Demand Draft
application_steps.description: Deposit farmer contribution share through designated government channel.

application_steps.title: Installation & Inspection
application_steps.description: Empanelled vendor sets up panels and pump followed by departmental commissioning.

name: Bihar Agricultural Mechanization Scheme (कृषि यांत्रिकीकरण योजना)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar
overview: Direct subsidies ranging from 40% to 80% on 90+ types of agricultural machinery (rotavators, power tillers, reapers, combine harvesters) for farmers in Bihar.
description: 40% to 80% subsidy on farm implements across all 38 districts of Bihar via the OFMAS portal.
benefits_summary: 40% to 80% subsidy on purchase of notified farm equipment; higher subsidy for SC/ST and small farmers
benefits_details: Subsidy released directly to farmer DBT account after physical verification of machinery serial numbers.
eligibility_criteria_text: Resident farmer of Bihar with a valid 13-digit Bihar DBT Farmer ID (Kisan Panjikaran) and current land revenue receipt (Malguzari Rashid) or LPC.

required_documents.name: Current Year Land Revenue Receipt (Malguzari Rashid) / LPC

application_steps.title: Check Bihar DBT Registration
application_steps.description: Ensure your 13-digit Farmer ID is active on https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in.

application_steps.title: Apply on OFMAS Portal
application_steps.description: Visit https://farmech.bih.nic.in and select desired equipment.

application_steps.title: Obtain Permit (Kray Aadesh)
application_steps.description: DAO issues online purchase permit upon application approval.

application_steps.title: Purchase & Geotag Verification
application_steps.description: Buy from empanelled dealer. Agriculture Coordinator conducts geotag verification for DBT release.

name: Bihar Diesel Anudan Scheme (बिहार डीजल अनुदान योजना)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar
overview: Emergency irrigation support grant providing ₹75 per litre diesel subsidy (₹750 per acre per irrigation) during dry weather conditions for standing crops in Bihar.
description: ₹75/litre irrigation diesel subsidy for owner and tenant farmers in Bihar during notified deficit rainfall spells.
benefits_summary: ₹750 per acre per irrigation (up to 3 irrigations for Kharif paddy/maize; up to 5 for vegetables)
benefits_details: Covers both raiyat (landowners) and gair-raiyat (tenant/sharecropper) farmers in Bihar up to 8 acres.
eligibility_criteria_text: Resident farmer of Bihar with active 13-digit Bihar DBT ID. Tenant farmers must provide self-declaration signed by 2 neighbouring farmers.

required_documents.name: Computerized Petrol Pump Diesel Bill with Registration Number
Land Receipt (LPC) OR Tenant Verification Declaration

application_steps.title: Buy Diesel with Computerized Receipt
application_steps.description: Ensure petrol pump prints your 13-digit DBT ID on the computerized receipt.

application_steps.title: Apply on Bihar DBT Portal
application_steps.description: Click 'डीजल अनुदान आवेदन' on https://dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in.

application_steps.title: Upload Bill & Land Details
application_steps.description: Submit crop, acreage, pump receipt, and tenant declaration if applicable.

application_steps.title: Coordinator Approval & Payment
application_steps.description: Krishi Samanvayak conducts field check and payment is credited to bank via PFMS.

name: UP Free Borewell Scheme (निःशुल्क बोरिंग योजना)
department: Minor Irrigation Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
overview: Provides 100% free shallow boring facilities and pump set purchase grants for small and marginal farmers across rural Uttar Pradesh.
description: Free shallow boring facility + up to ₹10,000 pump grant for small and marginal farmers in UP.
benefit: 100% free boring + up to ₹10,000 pump subsidy
benefits_summary: Zero cost drilling + up to ₹5,000 subsidy (General/OBC) or ₹10,000 (SC/ST) for pump sets
benefits_details: Targeted at farmers owning under 5 acres in non-dark zone blocks across UP.
eligibility_criteria_text: Small and marginal farmers residing in Uttar Pradesh with landholding under 2 hectares (5 acres) in non-dark groundwater blocks.

application_steps.title: Check Block Groundwater Status
application_steps.description: Confirm your village is in a safe groundwater zone (not a Dark Zone).

application_steps.title: Apply on UP Agri Portal / BDO Office
application_steps.description: Submit application online at http://upagripardarshi.gov.in or Block Development Office.

application_steps.title: Minor Irrigation Engineer Verification
application_steps.description: Field staff verify landownership and site feasibility.

application_steps.title: Boring Execution at Farm
application_steps.description: Government drilling contractor sinks the shallow tubewell at zero charge.

name: Karnataka Krishi Bhagya Scheme (ಕೃಷಿ ಭಾಗ್ಯ ಯೋಜನೆ)
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
overview: Subsidizes on-farm rainwater harvesting ponds (Krishi Honda), polythene lining, pump sets, and micro-sprinklers in rainfed dryland taluks of Karnataka.
description: 80% to 90% subsidy on farm ponds (Krishi Honda) and polythene lining in dryland Karnataka.
benefits_summary: 80% subsidy for General farmers, 90% for SC/ST farmers on farm pond package
benefits_details: Comprehensive package includes excavation, 500-micron UV sheet lining, pump set, and micro-sprinklers.
eligibility_criteria_text: Dryland farmers in Karnataka with minimum 1 acre holding registered on the Karnataka FRUITS portal.

application_steps.title: Check FRUITS FID Registration
application_steps.description: Verify your Farmer ID on https://fruits.karnataka.gov.in.

application_steps.title: Apply at Raitha Samparka Kendra
application_steps.description: Submit application at your local RSK with RTC extract.

application_steps.title: Field Layout & Work Order
application_steps.description: Assistant Agriculture Officer marks pond dimensions on your field.

application_steps.title: Pond Construction & Geotagging
application_steps.description: Excavate pond, install polythene sheet, and complete GPS measurement for DBT release.

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
overview: Dedicated national sub-program under DAY-NRLM improving women farmers' livelihoods through agro-ecological training, custom hiring, and credit linkages via SHGs.
description: Empowers women farmers through training, organic farm resources, toolkits, and microcredit linkages.
benefit: Free training + input toolkits + credit access
benefits_summary: Comprehensive agro-ecological training, equipment access via SHG Custom Hiring Centres, and revolving credit
benefits_details: No land ownership requirement. Priority for small, marginal, and single women farmers.
eligibility_criteria_text: Women farmers in rural areas actively engaged in farming or allied livelihoods. Membership in an NRLM Self Help Group (SHG) is required.

application_steps.title: Join Local NRLM SHG
application_steps.description: Enroll in your village Self Help Group facilitated by the State Rural Livelihood Mission.

application_steps.title: Choose Farm Activity
application_steps.description: Select organic cultivation, seed bank, or animal husbandry.

application_steps.title: Training by Krishi Sakhi
application_steps.description: Participate in hands-on organic input preparation and sustainable farming training.

application_steps.title: Access Toolkits & Revolving Fund
application_steps.description: Avail equipment from Custom Hiring Centres and low-interest input loans.
